status: DRAFT - not pushed. Engine reads this table; tooltips are generated from it.

curve.ramp45: v(r) = cap * (1 - exp(-3*(r/45)^1.6)) / (1 - exp(-3)); r = source rite rank (1..45). Gentle early, steep mid-game (r10-30), flattens at 45.

rules: Synergies add on top of base rite numbers and never replace them.
Damage-type synergies (dmgPct, extraHitFromHit, dotFromHit) on one rite total no more than +100% at rank 45 unless the text says so.
Bosses: effects marked (bosses: half) use half value; status durations on bosses are halved.
Use proposedCap when present, otherwise cap.
tooltipFormat: {targetName}: {text} (+{v}{unit}); v = valuePerRank at the current source rank, 1 decimal.
